name: SightRadar Face Recognition API MCP
description: Official MCP server for the SightRadar face recognition API: index photos, find every photo of a person from one selfie, compare and detect faces, and run batches. Endpoint: `https://mcp.sightradar.com/mcp` (OAuth sign-in or an API key; usage billed in prepaid credits) · Install: `npx -y sightradar-mcp` · [Docs](https://sightradar.com/mcp)
